messages:
amanda_pm: Heads-up — customer asked to expand next sprint's console observability scope. Wants better dashboards, a cost breakdown per-route, and tracing hooks for hot-paths. Need to decide what we can realistically ship. TL;DR: scope sculpting convo.
lucy_csm: customer is ACMEHealth, paying pilot. Their ask: per-tenant cost slice + root-cause trace links. They see this as blocker for rollout next month. :warning:
raj_engineer: quick reality check — dashboards and cost breakdown are mostly frontend + SQL work. Tracing hooks are infra-heavy: sampling, span tags, low-overhead correlation.
ellie_sre: agree with @raj_engineer. Tracing hooks could increase CPU on agents if we enable more span tags. We should define SLO for tracing overhead before committing.
michael_prodops: launch criteria suggestion: 1) dashboard templates for 3 common flows, 2) cost breakdown with per-route attribution, 3) tracing hooks behind feature flag and gated by perf regression <5%.
jordan_data: for cost breakdown we'll need these metrics: `tokens_per_request`, `gpu_seconds`, `model_variant`. I'll sketch a SQL join to attribute by org -> route.
raj_engineer: rough eng estimates: dashboards (3d frontend + 2d backend), cost attribution (4d data + 2d API), tracing hooks (8d infra + 3d agent tests). Total ~22 dev-days.
amanda_pm: tradeoff proposal: ship dashboards + cost breakdown in sprint 1, keep tracing hooks as beta behind flag in sprint 2 unless we can pare back scope. Customer can get dashboards earlier.
lucy_csm: pushback from customer: tracing hooks are high priority for their compliance audit. They can accept a limited-scope hook (only error-paths) if that helps.
ellie_sre: limited scope idea: instrument error-only traces + async span enrichment. That reduces runtime hit. Implementation sketch:

```
# agent config
trace.capture_on_error: true
trace.enrich_async: true
span.tags: ["request_id","route","model_variant"]
```

raj_engineer: that config looks reasonable. Error-only path cuts complexity: no always-on sampling, fewer KV cache touches. Update estimate for tracing hooks: 5d infra + 2d agent QA.
michael_prodops: need explicit rollback criteria for tracing rollout. Proposal: if p50 latency increase > 10ms or error-rate delta > +0.5% for 30m, auto-fallback to disabled flag.
amanda_pm: decision checkpoint for tomorrow's planning: 1) accept draft plan (dashboards + cost first, tracing error-only beta), 2) assign owners, 3) create acceptance tests and perf gates. @raj_engineer can you own tracing beta? @jordan_data owns cost attribution? :pray:
raj_engineer: can do. I'll open an RFC with proposed hooks and perf test plan.
jordan_data: I'll own cost attribution. Will post SQL prototype by EOD.
lucy_csm: I'll align ACMEHealth expectations and confirm they can accept error-only tracing as interim.
deploybot: deploy status: none — no deploys triggered by this thread.
amanda_pm: awesome — next step: owners open tickets and tag `#planning` board. We'll reconvene after RFC + SQL prototype. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ellie_sre: one more note — we'll run a smoke perf canary in prod-lab with 10% traffic before wider enablement.
raj_engineer: noted. I'll add canary steps to RFC.
michael_prodops: logging action items to launch checklist and alerting rules.
amanda_pm: great, closing thread for now. If something urgent pops, ping here.
